title: A closed subgroup of a product of finite groups is profinite
statement: Let $I$ be a set, let $(G_i)_{i\in I}$ be finite groups, each with the discrete topology, and give $G=\prod_{i\in I}G_i$ the product topology. If $H\le G$ is a closed subgroup, then $H$ with the subspace topology is a profinite group.
